subject: accounting
objective: Break-even when the contribution margin is almost exhausted
instruction: A reseller of generic components in Northport works on a very thin margin: the selling price is 100 USD per component and the purchase, handling and packaging cost is 98 USD, so each unit contributes almost nothing before fixed costs. Fixed costs for the month are 96000 USD. Required: report the break-even quantity in units, the contribution margin per unit, the contribution margin ratio, and the break-even revenue.
